intent_summary: Calibrated point-threshold crossings become inspectable observations, with adjacent crossings grouped into episodes.

criteria.criterion: A sufficiently extreme calibrated sample records a point trigger and the expectation it departed from.
criteria.notes: The injected spike retains its observed value, expectation, standardized residual, and point trigger.

criteria.criterion: Repeated runs of the same fixed request preserve numerical evidence; future samples do not change earlier scoring for declared settings.
criteria.notes: Assertions establish repeatability and unchanged earlier evidence under later evaluation changes with fixed seasonal settings. Automatic positional season discovery has the separately documented streaming limitation.

criteria.criterion: Adjacent point departures form a consecutive-run pattern with the contributing sample positions.
criteria.notes: The test checks one three-sample run, exact contributing positions, direction, and first detection.

criteria.criterion: Separated point departures remain separate episodes, and positional episode intervals use integer coordinates.
criteria.notes: Separated spikes produce two episodes without a consecutive-run pattern; positional evidence produces interval [9, 9].
